description:
Programme or Project Overview

Utrecht University's School of Economics invites applications for a Full Professor in Banking and Finance. The chair provides academic leadership for research and teaching in banking and finance, strengthens the school's profile in financial economics and represents the discipline within the university and its external networks.

The professor builds and leads a research group, supervises doctoral candidates, teaches in the school's programmes and takes responsibility for the quality and funding of the banking and finance line. The role includes organisational leadership duties and engagement with regulators, financial institutions and policy partners connected to the school's research agenda.

Candidate profile

Applicants have an outstanding international research record in banking, finance or financial economics, demonstrated leadership in research and teaching, and success in acquiring external funding. A clear vision for the discipline's development within the school is expected. The appointment is a full professorship on the Dutch professorial salary scale with a fixed application deadline.

Highlights

  • Academic leadership in banking and finance
  • Research group building and doctoral supervision
  • Teaching leadership in financial economics
  • External funding and partnerships
  • Engagement with regulators and financial institutions
  • Full professorship on the Dutch professorial scale

About Utrecht University

Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
